narrative.intro: Bechtel National is a major federal contractor with $73M in contract obligations recorded for FY2027 to date. Bechtel National booked one award so far in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $73M. Bechtel National obligations in FY2027 to date are down 93.9% year over year compared with the prior full fiscal year. Bechtel National posted multi-year obligations that ranged from $983M to $1.4B in FY22 through FY26, with prior-year totals of $1.2B, $1.4B, $983M, $1.1B, and $1.2B respectively. Bechtel National current-year totals are partial because FY2027 is fiscal year to date. Bechtel National figures on this page are contract obligations except where tables explicitly note award-value figures as total contract values. Bechtel National will likely show a much smaller footprint in FY2027 to date compared with the five prior full fiscal years based purely on the reported obligations totals and award count.
